The '''Bureau of Ships and Services data net''' was an information storage used by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] to keep record of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] registrations and [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]], [[Captain/Legends|captains]]' flight certifications, and listings of all weapon loadouts on all registered ships in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bureau of Ships and Services data net was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
